about.name: Coach Noel Ramos
about.title: DB's
about.bio:
Coach Noel Ramos is a proven 46085 specialist with 19 years of coaching experience at Frenship HS. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Ramos develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Ramos's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: Frenship HS's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 46085 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 46085 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
